name: Charged Greater Stormwater · Fire
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 6.25 ❤ lightning + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
• Light push
• Charge 189: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 16 targets in a row, jumps up to 8 blocks, 6.3 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
